title: cynometra minor
intro: Cynometra minor, commonly known as the minor ironwood or Borneo ironwood, is a plant species native to the tropical rainforests of Borneo. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Cynometra minor include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and scavenge free radicals. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
